استلزمت (form X)
# اِسْتَلْزَمْتُ (istalzamtu) /is.tal.zam.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَلْزَمَ (istalzama)
# اِسْتَلْزَمْتَ (istalzamta) /is.tal.zam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَلْزَمَ (istalzama)
# اِسْتَلْزَمْتِ (istalzamti) /is.tal.zam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَلْزَمَ (istalzama)
# اِسْتَلْزَمَتْ (istalzamat) /is.t
